info.title: API.SH: Kalshi
info.description: The Kalshi API from API.SH: public Kalshi data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Price history of a Kalshi market as candlesticks: per period the traded price (open, high, low, close, mean, previous), yes bid and yes ask OHLC, volume and open interest. Default range: the market's last year (daily), month (hourly) or day (minute).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kalshi-candlesticks

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Kalshi event with every market: per market the yes/no bid and ask, last and previous price, volume (total, 24 h), open interest, strikes, rules, open/close/expiration/settlement times, result and settlement value. Markets of older settled events come from the exchange's historical records (`historical: true`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kalshi-event

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Kalshi events (one question with one or more strike markets): ticker, series, title, subtitle, category, strike date, mutually-exclusive flag, settlement sources and, with `markets=1`, each market's prices, volume and open interest. Filter by status and series. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kalshi-events

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: open (default), closed, settled, unopened or all.

parameters.name: min_close
parameters.description: Only events with a market closing after this time (ISO or unix seconds).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Whether the Kalshi exchange and trading are open now, overall and per exchange segment, the estimated resume time during a pause, the standard weekly trading hours and any scheduled maintenance windows.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kalshi-exchange

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.timezone: America/New_York (times as the exchange lists them; 00:00-00:00 = open all day)

get.description:
One Kalshi market: title and subtitles, status, result, yes/no bid and ask, last and previous price, sizes, volume, 24 h volume, open interest, notional value, strikes, rules, early-close condition and every time (open, close, expiration, settlement). `book=1` adds the order book (yes and no bids) of an open market.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kalshi-market

parameters.name: book
parameters.description: true adds the order book (open markets).

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: With book: price levels per side (default all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The order book of one Kalshi market: yes and no bids with price and size (best price first), best bid and implied ask on each side, number of levels and total size per side. Settled markets answer with an empty book.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kalshi-orderbook

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Price levels per side (1-100, default all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Kalshi series (recurring market families, e.g. the Fed funds rate after each meeting) in one category, by traded volume: ticker, title, categories, tags, frequency, volume, fee type, settlement sources and contract documents. Filter by text and tag. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kalshi-series

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Economics, Politics, Elections, Sports, Financials, Crypto, Climate and Weather, Entertainment, Science and Technology, Companies, World, Commodities, Health, Social, Transportation, Mentions.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text in the ticker or title, e.g. `fed`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Recent public trades on Kalshi, newest first, for one market or across all markets: time, market ticker, taker side, yes and no price, contract count, block-trade flag and trade id. Cursor-paged.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kalshi-trades

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Market ticker to list trades for, e.g. `KXFED-27APR-T5.50`. Leave out for trades across all markets.

parameters.name: min_time
parameters.description: Only trades at or after this time (ISO date or unix seconds).

parameters.name: max_time
parameters.description: Only trades at or before this time (ISO date or unix seconds).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Value of `next_cursor` from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
